response.overview: Gaëlle Rouard (Films, 16mm spotlights, lights, objects, etc.)  Le Quan Ninh (turntables, vinyl records)  The filmmaker projects curls of her own films thanks to several 16 mm projectors and several screens, the images that can be distorted and deployed throughout the space thanks to a set of magnifying glass and mirrors. The musician creates the soundtrack of this film and luminous space by mixing disks of contemporary and electro-acoustic music from his personal collection as well as from the background of jarnage epicenter sound documents.  Turn, turn, turn with me, (ear and) my eye:  That turns on diamond beds  With pleasure before our eyes when the hand still unfolds  Swirl, dance a sound dance,  Like great lizards, drinking the gold of the Enlightenment, then flee under the curtains, then reappear again!
response.title: Silver Sillon
